beginner.title: Get started with Common Sense Media
beginner.outcome: You can: set up Common Sense Media, find your way around and finish a first small task
beginner.practice: Complete the official getting-started guide, then one small real task from your work

beginner.title: Set up for your family
beginner.outcome: You can: set up Common Sense Media for your household
beginner.practice: Set up Common Sense Media for one child or family member

beginner.title: Daily rhythm
beginner.outcome: You can: use Common Sense Media in daily family life
beginner.practice: Agree one family routine in Common Sense Media

intermediate.title: Rules and limits
intermediate.practice: Agree and set three rules together

intermediate.title: Talk about it
intermediate.outcome: You can: build trust, not just controls
intermediate.practice: Have one conversation about online safety

intermediate.title: Signature skills in Common Sense Media
intermediate.outcome: You can: use the features that make Common Sense Media distinctive
intermediate.practice: Use each of these features once on a real piece of work

expert.title: Advanced Common Sense Media
expert.outcome: You can: use Common Sense Media's advanced capabilities with confidence
expert.practice: Complete a project that needs at least two of these advanced capabilities

expert.title: Review and adapt
expert.outcome: You can: adjust as children grow

expert.title: Integrate Common Sense Media into your workflow
expert.outcome: You can: connect Common Sense Media with the other tools you use
expert.practice: Connect Common Sense Media to one other tool you use and remove one manual step

expert.title: Lead and teach others
expert.outcome: You can: set standards and teach others to use Common Sense Media well
expert.practice: Write a one-page "how we use Common Sense Media" guide and teach it to one person

expert_validation.note: Generated from the archetype template plus tool-specific signature skills; to be reviewed by a practitioner.
